task_completion.description: The blog post title is correctly entered as 'The Future of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The title field in the WordPress editor contains the exact string 'The Future of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare'.

task_completion.description: The post content is at least 100 words and includes the five required keywords.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The main editor body contains a substantial amount of text. The VLM should identify the presence of 'artificial intelligence', 'healthcare', 'diagnostics', 'treatment', and 'patient care' within the text.

task_completion.description: The post is assigned to the 'Technology' category.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the document settings sidebar, the 'Technology' checkbox is checked under the Categories section.

task_completion.description: The four required tags ('AI', 'healthcare', 'technology', 'featured') are added to the post.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Tags section in the sidebar displays four distinct tag bubbles or labels for 'AI', 'healthcare', 'technology', and 'featured'.

task_completion.description: The post is successfully published, not just saved as a draft.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Publish' button is clicked, and a confirmation message like 'Post published' or a 'View Post' link appears. The status in the sidebar should change to 'Published'.

integrity.description: The agent used the WordPress web interface rather than executing CLI commands to create the post.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the WordPress dashboard, typing in the editor, and clicking sidebar elements.

integrity.description: The agent wrote actual content rather than using 'Lorem Ipsum' or repeating the keywords without context.
integrity.visual_evidence: The text in the editor forms coherent sentences discussing AI in healthcare, not just a list of keywords or filler text.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the WordPress menu to 'Posts' -> 'Add New'.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the transition from the WordPress dashboard to the post editor via the sidebar menu.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The post must be titled 'The Future of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare'. It must be in the 'Technology' category. Required tags: 'AI', 'healthcare', 'technology', 'featured'. Required keywords in body: 'artificial intelligence', 'healthcare', 'diagnostics', 'treatment', 'patient care'. The content must be at least 100 words long. The final status must be 'Published'.
